description: This file defines a shared informer factory for Kubernetes custom controllers, including configuration options, lifecycle management, and resource informers.

classes.name: sharedInformerFactory
classes.description: Implements the SharedInformerFactory interface, managing informers, lifecycle, and configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts all informers in separate goroutines, handling shutdown via stop channel.

methods.name: StartWithContext
methods.description: Starts all informers with a context, allowing cancellation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Signals shutdown, waits for goroutines to finish, and releases resources.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSync
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synchronized or stop channel is closed.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSyncWithContext
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synchronized or context is canceled.

methods.name: InformerFor
methods.description: Returns a shared informer for a given runtime object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Samplecontroller
methods.description: Returns the samplecontroller interface for this factory.
